description: Defines callback functions for nghttp2 HTTP/2 library integration within the http2::adapter namespace, including functions for frame handling, data chunks, and error reporting.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Callback when the library is ready to send serialized frames.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Callback when a frame header has been received.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback when a complete frame has been received.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Callback at the start of a headers frame.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Callback when a name-value header has been received.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Callback immediately before sending a frame.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Callback immediately after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Callback when a non-DATA frame is not sent due to an error.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback when an invalid frame is received.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Callback when a data chunk from a DATA frame payload is received.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Callback when a stream has been closed.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Callback when a chunk of extension frame data is passed to the application.

methods.name: OnUnpackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback when nghttp2 wants the application to unpack an extension payload.

methods.name: OnPackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback when nghttp2 is ready to pack an extension payload.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Callback when the library has an error message to deliver.
